name: Dashboard - KPI overview and navigation
description: Verifies the main dashboard page loads with KPI cards, charts, and correct role-based navigation

planSteps.description: Log in with gerente credentials and navigate to /dashboard
Assert that dashboard loads with KPI metric cards (active orders, pending proposals, open costs, etc.)
Assert that the sidebar navigation shows all menu items: Dashboard, Work Requests, Orders, Proposals, Planning, Execution, Evidences, Reports, Billing, Admin
Assert that the notification bell icon is present in the top bar
Click on each sidebar navigation link and verify the corresponding page loads without error
Resize browser to mobile width (375px) and verify sidebar becomes a hamburger drawer menu
Assert that mobile drawer can be opened and closed, and navigation still works
